messages.author: bafbff7f5abd72d1
messages.subject: Error: passing unknown arguments: save_all_pars
parts:
Hi All

I've been trying to estimate two models that I then plan to compare using bayes_factor(). In order to do this, the models have to be run with the additional command: save_all_pars = TRUE, however, this seems to be leading to an error.

This is the code I have tried running:

    library(bridgesampling)
    library(brms)
    m1<-brm (DV ~ IV+(1+IV|Subject) + (1|Item), data=data, family="bernoulli", prior = prior, save_all_pars = TRUE, warmup = 1000, iter = 2000, chains = 20)

However, I am getting this error, after which R stops running estimating the model:

    Error: passing unknown arguments: save_all_pars.

Does anyone have any suggestions?

Thank you!
